cues: When it grabs oxygen instead, RuBP gives one 3-PGA and one useless two-carbon phosphoglycolate.
Salvaging it takes a loop through the chloroplast, the peroxisome and the mitochondrion, and on the way carbon dioxide is lost and ATP is spent, with no gain at all.
text: When it grabs oxygen instead, RuBP gives one 3-PGA and one useless two-carbon phosphoglycolate. Salvaging it takes a loop through the chloroplast, the peroxisome and the mitochondrion, and on the way carbon dioxide is lost and ATP is spent, with no gain at all. This is photorespiration.
